data.name: PixellBytes' Adjustable Party Limit
data.summary: Adds spells that allow you to set the maximum number of party members to any value between 1-16! Also fixes a variety of bugs and issues related to higher party limits. This mod does NOT allow you to have more than 4 players in multiplayer.

modfile.changelog:
New Features:

- The "Seeming" spell can now disguise up to 16 party members at once instead of 4.



Bug Fixes:

- Fixed an issue where once the party crash landed on the beach at the start of the game, anytime the UNSET LIMIT was changed, the actual party limit would change too.

data.name: Ancient Mega Pack
data.summary: Experience BG3 revolution: 2500 masterfully crafted artifacts seamlessly merged with vanilla loot pools. Smart randomization creates truly unique playthroughs while maintaining perfect balance. Turn every run into an exciting treasure hunt! Feedback!

modfile.changelog:
Hotfix 7.4.1 / The Last Pass — June 13

GENERAL CHANGES
A new ULTRA mini-boss now answers the call: a loud, fast brawler who cracks skulls with a club he swears is a silver sword and grows deadlier the longer you let him keep swinging. Shkath zai!
Eclipse no longer pierces immunities, only resistances
Eclipse now leaves the boss immune to force, fire and cold damage
Eclipse's tooltip was split into cleaner paragraphs (all supported languages)
Eclipse now also cleanses more negative effects that weren't accounted for before
Acid slimes no longer spawn outside of combat and properly dissolve when the fight ends (thanks @Bish)
Acid slimes no longer hold a grudge against their owner
Eclipse's stunning flash is a bit tighter now and slightly harder to shrug off
Dousing the Pyre with acid or radiant now knocks it down more reliably every round, but each splash counts for less
With Avarice active, felling the Adamantine Golem now also slips an epic-grade reward cube into the host's pack (thanks @gabsch)
Auto-selling certain odd pickups like a milk bottle or a barrel should no longer crash the game (thanks @vidarwolf)
Interplanar chests now spawn a touch higher, so they stop sinking into the floor (this won't work for every spawn point)
The Glass shard now actually stuns its wearer when they take damage, as the name rather strongly implied. Its spell crits also went from guaranteed to merely very likely
The Phlegethos shard's fire burst was dialed down, so loading a fistful of them onto one ring no longer snowballs into a bonfire
The Warlock shard's tooltip stops printing a broken value and finally admits its cantrip bonus equals your Strength modifier
The unarmed Armour Class shard actually grants its bonus now
The same unarmed damage shard can no longer be stacked onto one ring repeatedly
The critical strikes shard's tooltip now shows the true doubled dice
The Primordial Chaos shard now respects the stack limit instead of quietly sailing past it
The Improvisation shard turned a deep Bardic Inspiration pool into a cantrip machine gun, one cast per die. Its discount now fires once per turn
Probably fixed an issue where ULTRA mini-bosses wouldn't spawn on Myrkul
Your summoned creatures no longer pad out how many ULTRA mini-bosses show up
A mirroring ULTRA mini-boss only ever copies a real party member now, never a summoned pet
ULTRA mini-bosses that outlive the boss they came to aid now hunt the party down without mercy
ULTRA mini-bosses no longer scatter their own supplies when they fall
One ULTRA mini-boss's twin blades now bite with a chance to root whoever they cut
The cantrip reroll shard now trades away weapon accuracy in exchange
The guaranteed spell crit shard climbed to the rarest tier where it belongs (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
The Reclamation shard no longer multiplies returned shards after save reloads (thanks @Bish)

ITEM CHANGES
Primordial Chaos charges now respect their cap
The Potent Magic ring generates its charges again and honors the cap (thanks @ayrandros)
The Blade Ward armour's protection bonuses should now apply reliably (thanks @GGTsune)
Several pieces of gear that key off Mage Armor now read it on the wearer instead of the wrong target
A couple of items were loitering in the wrong rarity reward pool. They now drop from the planar coin that actually matches their rarity
The acid ring raises its decomposition aura right at the start of combat (thanks @77099)
The Whispering Vein's Carnage's Gift now stops stacking at its cap
The Miraculous Magic ring now reacts to harmful effects only, with a far better chance of soothing the wearer
The psychic knuckles' throw rider now states how far the target is flung
Three Paths of Shou Lung's wind stance no longer blinds on the lower tiers, but no longer grants the extra bonus action either
The knuckles now explain their special base strike, and the higher tiers make your fists count as magical
Adamantine forge gear now salvages at a humbler tier (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
Legendary unarmed damage shards now escalate their side effects properly (thanks @wh1te_ghost)
The Master's Cloak of Sacrifice no longer comforts your enemies (thanks @shyhvfgb)
The hydra cloak's recoil now bites its own wearer for the right amount (thanks @Fujita Zebi)
The Sovereign Tails' Leaden Limbs curse now shows an icon that actually exists (thanks @Vludber)
The Spellweaver greaves now honor the Potent Magic and Chaos stack cap their own tooltip kept promising
The Potent Magic tooltip now explains that its bonus scales with the effect's remaining duration (all supported languages)
The Jolly Lads disguise's Dex cap is now gone
The Uncommon perfection ring quietly shipped with the rarer tiers' warding interrupt. It does not anymore
The venomfang shortsword stops ignoring poison resistance at Rare, and shrugging off poison immunity is now a Legendary-only privilege rather than a Very Rare freebie
The soul cloak now props up Charisma saving throws from its very first tier instead of leaving them empty until Legendary
The vine longsword's Very Rare tier handed out a free entangling strike and razor gale every single turn. Both are now once per fight, like a normal weapon

VISUALS
The Crown of the Vengeful Spirits' visuals were fully reworked so repeated triggers no longer flood the screen

LOCALIZATION
German localization brought up to date with 7.4 (thanks @Zoey)

modfile.changelog:
This combines versions 9.11, 9.10.12, 9.10.11, 9.10.10, 9.10.9, 9.10.8, and 9.10.7.

// Summary //

I've been doing a proper modded playthrough instead of playtesting my mod, but I keep running into potential fixes. So uh, now you have them. Enjoy!

// Version 9.11 //

- QUEST FIX! Corrupted Grimoire message box no longer pops mid-cutscene when you're initially unlocking Necromancy of Thay. This was causing folks to miss out on the bonuses as the rewards are tied to clicking "Accept". Unfortunately, that cutscene ends automatically and negates any message boxes opened during it. It now only triggers after the cutscene concludes and not before.
- QUEST FIX! Added a fix for those who unlocked the Necromancy of Thay, but missed out on the bonuses from Corrupted Grimoire due to the issue above. The quest pop-up will now retrigger after a Long Rest. It might be that the side-effect of my doing this means all DOs get the bonuses regardless if they were the ones that opened the book. Unsure about this, give it a whirl.
- NERF! Reduced the size of the blood puddles created by my scythes and Aeternusvitae. It was a little too excessive. This isn't a Quentin Tarantino film.
- NERF! Connor's Warding Bond variant now only provides resistances to physical and psychic damage. It also loses its bonuses to AC and Saving Throws. This is intended to severely nerf Connor as he was making the rest of Act 1 trivial even in Honor Mode as soon as you get him.
- QUEST MECHANICS CHANGED! Totems of the Necromancer are no longer deactivated before the Profane Blessing message boxes are closed/accepted. This is to ensure that you're able to re-interact with the totems if a cutscene interrupts you mid-interaction. For example, interacting with the totem in Myconid colony owned by the Sovereign will rightfully trigger a crime check if you **** with it without sneaking, but this will sometimes cause the totems to be deactivated prior to you accepting the bonuses making you unable to grab it the second time.

// Version 9.10.12 //

- Bloodmarch from the Sabaton of the Lich King has a new icon.
- Bloodmarch now works on any blood surface in addition to the ability to teleport to bleeding targets.
- Changed the scythes to inflict bleeding and creates a blood surface beneath characters hit. To be honest, this is just to give more opportunities for Bloodmarch uses.
- Blood surface created by Aeternusvitae actually lasts a while.
- A powerful bell from Act 2 will now grant you the ability call "Release from Service" to remove undead NPC followers, including dead ones. This is mainly for folks who have issues with dead undead NPCs remaining stuck on your portrait as red squares. It lasts until Long Rest, after which you must ring the bell again to gain the spell back.
- As always, if you're updating to this latest version, try adding a new innocuous, easily removable mod to your load order to force your game to recompile as this mod has changes to its Osiris script.

// Version 9.10.11 //

- "Reinforcements from the Dread Citadel" aka the Gather Your Allies bonus from your patron, will no longer spawn 100+ undead allied NPCs during the courtyard fight. Hahaha, oops. I promised an epic fight, but not that epic!

// Version 9.10.10 //

- BUFF! Connor Vinderblad's should now be able to Help his undead consorts—relevant to players who use mods that turn them undead.
- Fixed Phylactery spell's description. It claimed that you can bind to 3, you can only bind to 1.
- BUFF! Added quarterstaves and daggers to the list of weapons that could be ignited by Necrotic Armaments when wielded in the offhand.
- BUFF! Aspect of the Dread Overlord's Consume Soul damage buffed by 50%. It was doing bupkis damage at higher difficulties.
- BUFF! Aspect of the Dread Overlord's Cursed Fire Breath's damage doubled.
- BUFF! Aspect of the Dread Overlord's attacks now ignore resistances and immunity to Necrotic, Psychic, and Fire damage. He no longer merely tickles enemies.
- BUFF! Cooldown for Aspect of the Dread Overlord's AoE attack reduced to 2 turns.
- KINDA LIKE A BUFF? Aeternusvitae and Dark Empathy now causes enemies to bleed beneath their feet. I mainly added this because the spell already applies Bleeding and I want more opportunities for the Sabatons of the Lich King's Bloodmarch passive to be useful. Also, Path of Undeath blood pool bonuses.

// Version 9.10.9//

- The initial Corrupted Grimoire bonus should now last uh, forever instead of 6 seconds.
- Fixed Profane Power: Exhort the Risen's Approach variant. It was applying both Approach and Halt.

// Version 9.10.8 //

- Armors of the Soulshepherd now benefit from Fighting Style: Defense.

// Version 9.10.7 //

- You no longer lose/regain the Profane Blessing: Corrupted Grimoire bonuses when you respec. They're now permanent. Obviously, your Soul Magnet is absolutely useless without Shield of Souls.
- Undead NPCs added to your party via a secret powerful artefact are now removed from your party if they die. Probably.
- The spell to summon the Dread Overlord is now granted to all cultists regardless of level upon entering the endgame (well, you have to conclude the Gather Your Allies cutscene first).
- Removed redundant bound status from Libor Mortis. Not retroactive.
